searched: Kalshi NBA on X (sent by you)
summary: First run, a test of the route: claims from this month's coverage instead of one night's. From tomorrow, each morning covers the night before.

items.claim: Dončić had nine straight games of 30+ points, 5+ rebounds and 5+ assists, tying the longest such run in NBA history
items.note: Our box scores agree: nine straight through 11/11 (32-5-5 that night). It ended 11/15 (43 points, 3 rebounds). Our streak list has no streak for a combined line like 30-5-5.
items.cut: streaks of a combined line (30+ points with 5+ rebounds and 5+ assists, and the like), against the longest on file

items.claim: Dončić's 468 points through 12 games were the most through a season's first 12 in the last 50 years, passing James Harden's 464
items.note: 468 through his first 12 games, in our box scores. Our files go back to 1993-94, so the 50-year part is the league's to say; nothing on the site sets points through N games against past seasons.
items.cut: points (and other totals) through a player's first N games of a season, against every season on file

items.claim: Ten Grizzlies scored in double figures against the Pelicans, a franchise record
items.note: Our 11/13 box score: 10 Grizzlies with 10+ points in the 142-111 win. The franchise record part goes past our files' 1993-94 start for Vancouver/Memphis only in name; it fits what we hold.
items.cut: players in double figures in one game, against the team's games on file

items.claim: Josh Hart hasn't scored in double figures since Oct. 25
items.note: He has since scored 11 (11/19), 10 (11/22) and 15 (11/25). The site has his real slide: 28-for-92 from the field over 12 games.

items.claim: Jayson Tatum in the 4th quarter of his last six games: 3.7 points a game, 6-25 FG, 1-13 from three, 9-15 FT
items.note: Our play-by-play gives the same numbers; the Streaks page's 4th-quarter scan has had it since this morning (his last 8: 7-27, 1-14).
